objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed artifact representing policies, guidelines, procedural instructions, work instructions, or other controlled content that undergoes creation, editing, approval, distribution, and archiving.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: The classification of the document such as Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, or Work Instruction

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: A short code prefix assigned to each document type (e.g., RL for Guideline, PO for Policy)

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: A cross-client consecutive 4-digit number assigned to each document of its type

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: The name or heading of the document

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current workflow state of the document such as In Editing, Under Review, Released, or Out of Force

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: The revision level of the document

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: The date from which the document becomes effective

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: The date after which the document is no longer valid

attributes.name: content
attributes.description: The body or substantive material of the document

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: The original file format such as Word, Excel, or PowerPoint

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other documents related to this document

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: System applications referenced or relevant to the document

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: The companies or areas to which the document applies

objs.name: template
objs.description: A predefined document structure that can be selected when creating new documents of a specific type, with embedded TAG technology for automatic metadata insertion.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: The type of document for which the template is designed

attributes.name: format
attributes.description: The file format of the template

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document linked to a main document that is automatically released with the main document and triggers versioning when created, modified, or archived.

attributes.name: content
attributes.description: The file or document content

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: The version number of the attachment

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The release status aligned with the main document

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: Supplementary material attached to a document that is not subject to the release cycle and does not create new versions of the main document.

attributes.name: content
attributes.description: The supplementary material or information

attributes.name: release_status
attributes.description: Whether the additional information is published or not

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A suggested modification to a document that does not affect the document's version history until accepted and implemented.

attributes.name: proposed_change
attributes.description: The modification or update being suggested

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The state of the proposal such as Pending, Scheduled, or Completed

objs.name: user
objs.description: A person who interacts with documents in defined roles such as Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, or Translator.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: The function assigned to the user such as Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, or Translator

attributes.name: authorization
attributes.description: The specific permissions granted to the user

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A collection of users organized together for the purpose of assigning common authorizations and distribution.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The identifier of the user group

attributes.name: members
attributes.description: The users belonging to the group

objs.name: signature
objs.description: An electronic record documenting that a user has completed a workflow task such as creation, review, or release of a document.

attributes.name: participant
attributes.description: The user who provided the signature

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time the signature was applied

attributes.name: workflow_step
attributes.description: The phase of the process during which the signature was collected

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A maintained record of users and user groups who should receive a document and/or provide acknowledgement upon its release.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Either Distribution by Email or Distribution for Acknowledgement

attributes.name: recipients
attributes.description: The users or user groups included in the distribution

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: An activity assigned to a user within the document approval process, such as creation, review, or release.

attributes.name: task_type
attributes.description: The nature of the task such as Creator, Reviewer, or Releaser

attributes.name: assigned_to
attributes.description: The user responsible for completing the task

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Whether the task is pending or completed

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: A system-generated or manual request to confirm or update the continued validity of a document.

attributes.name: document
attributes.description: The document for which validity is being checked

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The state of the request such as Pending or Completed

attributes.name: process_type
attributes.description: Whether processing involves releasers only or includes authors, reviewers, and releasers

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: A request to invalidate and archive a document that no longer has validity, removing it from active circulation.

attributes.name: document
attributes.description: The document being invalidated

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The state of the invalidation process

attributes.name: process_type
attributes.description: Whether processing involves releasers only or includes initiator, reviewers, and releasers

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A request to restore a previously invalidated and archived document to active status.

attributes.name: document
attributes.description: The archived document being reactivated

attributes.name: initiator
attributes.description: The user requesting reactivation, must be from Business Admin group

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The state of the reactivation request

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: A record of confirmation by a user that they have reviewed and understood a document distributed for acknowledgement.

attributes.name: user
attributes.description: The person confirming the acknowledgement

attributes.name: document
attributes.description: The document being acknowledged

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time the acknowledgement was confirmed

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Whether the acknowledgement is pending or confirmed

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: A role-specific interface displaying documents and tasks relevant to the user based on their permissions and distribution assignments.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: The user role for which the dashboard is configured

attributes.name: content
attributes.description: The documents and tasks displayed

objs.name: report
objs.description: A role-specific evaluation or search function providing filtered views of documents and their status according to selected criteria.

attributes.name: report_type
attributes.description: The category of report such as Status Report or Search Report

attributes.name: selection_parameters
attributes.description: The criteria used to filter results

attributes.name: target_role
attributes.description: The user role for which the report is designed

objs.name: archive_group
objs.description: A special user group with read access to archived and invalidated documents for historical and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: members
attributes.description: Users with archive access rights

objs.name: business_admin_group
objs.description: A user group with authority to create reactivation requests for invalidated documents.

attributes.name: members
attributes.description: Users with business administration authority

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: A translated version of a released document that must undergo its own approval process before becoming visible to readers.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: The target language of the translation

attributes.name: original_document
attributes.description: The document being translated

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The approval status of the translated version

objs.name: client
objs.description: A separate organizational instance or tenant in a multi-client system, each with its own document visibility and management settings.

attributes.name: identifier
attributes.description: The unique identifier for the client

attributes.name: document_visibility
attributes.description: Which documents are visible or hidden in this client
